value.name: Master of Science in Computer Science

facts.evidence: CEMSE Division: 'The MS in Computer Science requires 36 credit hours of coursework and research, typically completed in two academic years.'

value.notes: SAR 0 tuition. All admitted graduate students receive the KAUST Fellowship covering 100% full tuition support, on-campus housing, medical and dental coverage, and an annual living stipend ($20,000–$30,000).

facts.evidence: KAUST Fellowship: 'All admitted students receive the KAUST Fellowship, which provides full tuition coverage, monthly living allowance, housing, and relocation assistance.'

facts.value: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or related field with a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.5 on a 4.0 scale (or equivalent first-class honours from India); 3 recommendation letters; statement of purpose; GRE general test is recommended.
facts.evidence: KAUST Admissions Criteria: 'Applicants must hold a Bachelor's degree in a relevant STEM discipline with minimum 3.5/4.0 GPA.'

facts.value: TOEFL iBT 79 or IELTS Academic 6.5 minimum (KAUST admissions code 4107).
facts.evidence: Language guidelines: Minimum score of 79 on the TOEFL iBT or 6.5 on the IELTS Academic test.
Admissions Timeline: Priority application deadline for Fall admission is mid-January.
